pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every pin: every input lands in an unconditional pin flop (data) or a reset pin flop (valid/strobe/status), every output is a flop Q (HBMA-HOST 2026-10-17 audit of the source); a kit flop stage would add a redundant edge

job.purpose: Measured predecessor has 446 um2 std area and 895 pins. 51.84 square is pin-bound: 256-bit buses occupy separate N/S/E full faces at <6 pins/um; all narrow control and clock W. Predicted utilization ~20% is a physical pin-count limit, explicitly requires coordinator floorplan exception before adoption.

slot_change_request: HBM-SMB-KITS -> HBM die lead: 51.84 square pin-bound cp_svg slot; W controls, N cfg_data, S a_data, E b_data; unchanged cfg/run cycles. Needs pin-bound utilization exception (~20%).
